# jumpcloud_authentication_policy (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud authentication policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_authentication_policy" "portal_mfa" {
  id = "5f0c1234abcdef567890abcd"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the authentication policy.

### Read-Only

- `conditions` (Attributes) Conditions that determine when this policy applies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is disabled.
- `effect` (Attributes) The effect when the policy conditions are met. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--effect))
- `name` (String) The name of the authentication policy.
- `targets` (Attributes List) Target resources this policy applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))
- `type` (String) The policy type.

<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Read-Only:

- `device_trusted` (Boolean) Whether the device must be trusted.
- `geo_ip_in` (List of String) Country codes the request must originate from.
- `geo_ip_not_in` (List of String) Country codes the request must not originate from.
- `ip_address_in` (List of String) IP list IDs that the request IP must match.
- `ip_address_not_in` (List of String) IP list IDs that the request IP must not match.


<a id="nestedatt--effect"></a>
### Nested Schema for `effect`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) The action to take: allow or deny.
- `mfa_allowed_factors` (List of String) Allowed MFA factor types.
- `mfa_required` (Boolean) Whether MFA is required.


<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The target resource ID.
- `type` (String) The target resource type.
